queue.failure.check.environment.text: {what} failed for the environment, not the work ({cause}{code})
queue.failure.check.environment.note: {what}: the check (queue.failure.check.*). {cause}: why, as recorded (queue.failure.temporary when none). {code}: ": " and its code, or nothing.

queue.failure.check.failed.note: {what}: the check (queue.failure.check.*): it failed on the work merged with its target.

queue.failure.check.install.text: the install before the merge checks
queue.failure.check.install.note: The merge check that failed: the install that runs before them.

queue.failure.check.named.note: The merge check that failed, by its name.

queue.failure.check.some.note: A merge check that failed, its name not known.

queue.failure.conflict.note: What came back: a conflict merging into {target} (its files follow, queue.failure.in).

queue.failure.focused.newProof.text: the merge needs real-CLI or packaged focused tests its review never ran: {tests}
queue.failure.focused.newProof.note: G20 (HI-1367): the merge needs focused tests the queue doesn't run and the review didn't either. {tests}: the tests, as many as fit.

queue.failure.focused.noProof.text: no counted review run at the submitted revision for its real-CLI or packaged focused tests: {tests}
queue.failure.focused.noProof.note: G20 (HI-1367): focused tests the queue doesn't run had no counted run at the submitted revision. {tests}: the tests, as many as fit.

queue.failure.focused.noRunner.text: the project has no command to run its focused tests
queue.failure.focused.noRunner.note: G20 (HI-1367): no focused-test command in the project.

queue.failure.focused.none.text: no focused tests were chosen for its submission
queue.failure.focused.none.note: G20 (HI-1367): its submission had no focused tests chosen.

queue.failure.focused.repick.text: its focused tests couldn't be chosen for what changed in the merge: {paths}
queue.failure.focused.repick.note: G20 (HI-1367): its focused tests couldn't be picked for the merge. {paths}: the paths, as many as fit.

queue.failure.folderBusy.text: the folder {target} is checked out in was busy
queue.failure.folderBusy.note: What came back: the folder its target branch is checked out in was busy.

queue.failure.hook.text: a git hook refused its merge commit
queue.failure.hook.note: What came back: a git hook refused the merge commit.

queue.failure.in.note: {head}: what came back (queue.failure.conflict). {files}: its files, each with where its conflicts are when they fit (HI-1181).

queue.failure.notUpToDate.text: it isn't up to date with {target}
queue.failure.notUpToDate.note: What came back: under Strict, the card isn't up to date with its target.

queue.failure.notUpToDate.files.note: HI-1181 round 1: Strict's update conflicted. {head}: queue.failure.notUpToDate. {files}: its files and where, as a conflict's are.

queue.failure.targetMoved.text: {target} moved while it was being merged
queue.failure.targetMoved.note: What came back: its target branch moved during the merge.

queue.failure.temporary.note: The cause of a check that failed for its environment, when none was recorded.

queue.files.count.note: A list of files when none of their names fits: how many.

queue.files.more.note: A list of files cut to fit: {files} the first ones, {n} how many more.

queue.line.left.text: {who} It left the merge queue: {why, select, decision {a decision since its approval needs it reviewed again} other {its pass is stale}}.
queue.line.left.note: {who}: queue.line.who. {why}: decision (a decision since its approval) or stale (its pass).

queue.line.merged.note: A card the merge queue merged.

queue.line.notYet.text: {who} Once it is approved, the merge queue merges it and moves it to Done.
queue.line.notYet.note: {who}: queue.line.who. Not in the queue yet: it goes in once approved.

queue.line.paused.text: {who} It is in the merge queue for {target}, which is paused ({reason}, on {card}); {waits}.
queue.line.paused.note: {who}: queue.line.who. {reason}: the pause's code (as the window's queue names it). {card}: the card it paused on. {waits}: what it waits for (queue.paused.*), never a step of the agent's own (#1406).

queue.line.queued.text: {who} It is in the merge queue for {target}, position {position}; it moves to Done once merged.
queue.line.queued.note: {who}: queue.line.who. {target}: the branch it merges into. {position}: 1 is next, after the one testing now.

queue.line.returned.note: {who}: queue.line.who. {returned}: what came back and what to do next (queue.returned.*).

queue.line.stale.text: {who} Its pass is for {approved}, but its line is at {current} (changed since): submit it again for review (cw_submit); it is queued once that is approved.
queue.line.stale.note: HI-1763: approved with a stale pass, never queued (HI-1737 sat so, its lane paused, nobody told). {who}: queue.line.who. {approved}, {current}: short revisions ("—" for none).

queue.line.testing.text: {who} The merge queue is {step, select, advance {moving {target} to its merge} checks {running the merge checks on its merge into {target}} other {testing its merge into {target}}} now; it moves to Done once merged.
queue.line.testing.note: {who}: queue.line.who. {target}: the branch it merges into. {step}: the queue's step with it (advance, checks; other: another or not known here).

queue.line.unenforced.text: Combwork merges this card (its rules), but workflow rules aren't enforced: merge it yourself and report the merge (cw_report_merge).
queue.line.unenforced.note: A card read under Combwork merges while Settings → Advanced: workflow rules are enforced is off: nothing refuses, so the agent merges and reports as before 1.0.

queue.line.who.text: Combwork merges this card (its rules): don't merge it yourself.
queue.line.who.note: The first sentence of every queue line for a card Combwork's merge queue merges (#1354): the agent never merges it itself.

queue.next.conflict.text: Merge {target} into your worktree, resolve the conflict, commit and submit again (cw_submit).
queue.next.conflict.note: The next step after a conflict with {target}, the branch.

queue.next.fix.text: Fix it in your worktree, commit and submit again (cw_submit).
queue.next.fix.note: The next step after anything else that came back.

queue.next.proof.text: Have its reviewer run those tests at the revision submitted (cw-progress --check "focused:<test>"), then submit the same revision again (cw_submit).
queue.next.proof.note: The next step when its focused tests that the queue doesn't run need a counted run (G20, HI-1367).

queue.next.repick.text: Bring your worktree up to date, then submit again naming the tests the change needs (tests on cw_submit), for review.
queue.next.repick.note: The next step when its focused tests couldn't be chosen (G20, HI-1367).

queue.next.runner.text: Tell the user: Version Control → Each card’s focused tests needs the command that runs them.
queue.next.runner.note: The next step when the project has no focused-test command: the setting is the user's (a tab and option name, as the window shows them).

queue.next.transient.text: Submit the same revision again (cw_submit): it goes straight back into the queue, at most twice in a row.
queue.next.transient.note: The next step after a failure of the environment, not the work.

queue.paused.approval.text: it moves on once the user answers, in For you, whether to update {target} now
queue.paused.approval.note: What a queue paused for the user's answer waits for (#1406): whether to update a checked-out target now (Resume doesn't stand in for it). {target}: the branch.

queue.paused.fix.text: it moves on once the user fixes what stopped it and resumes it
queue.paused.fix.note: What a queue paused on a step that needs the user waits for (#1406): git's error, a push (G18, #1179), then Resume.

queue.paused.folder.text: it moves on once the user puts right the folder {target} is checked out in and resumes it
queue.paused.folder.note: What a queue paused on the folder its target is checked out in waits for (#1406). {target}: the branch.

queue.paused.mergeChoice.text: it moves on once the user chooses, in For you, how Combwork merges this project (merge style and commit message)
queue.paused.mergeChoice.note: What a queue paused for the project's merge style waits for (#1406).

queue.paused.resume.text: it moves on once the user resumes it
queue.paused.resume.note: What any other paused queue waits for: the user's Resume (#1406).

queue.paused.rules.text: it paused while workflow rules were off; it moves on once they are enforced again (if they already are, once the user resumes it)
queue.paused.rules.note: What a queue paused while workflow rules weren't enforced waits for (#1406): Combwork resumes it once they are.

queue.paused.stuck.text: it moves on once the user settles its interrupted advance (their answer in For you, or Resume)
queue.paused.stuck.note: What a queue paused on an interrupted advance waits for (#1406): Decide in For you, or Resume once settled.

queue.returned.lastLines.note: The last lines of a returned card's output, joined with " | " and cut from their start ("…") to fit.

queue.returned.lead.note: {subject}: the card (its key, or queue.returned.subjectIt). {cameBack}: "came back from the merge queue". {failure}: what came back (queue.failure.*).

queue.returned.log.note: A returned card's log, by its path, where it fits.

queue.returned.logPointer.note: Where a returned card's log path is, when the path itself doesn't fit.

queue.returned.subjectIt.note: The subject of a returned card's sentence in its own card read (a wake names it by its key).

queue.wake.left.decision.text: {card} left the merge queue: a decision since its approval needs it reviewed again. Read its decisions (cw_read_task){to, select, review {; it is back in Review, and queued again once approved.} other {, then submit again (cw_submit).}}
queue.wake.left.decision.note: #1354: its builder's wake for a card that left the queue for a decision since its approval. {to}: review (it went back to Review) or active.

queue.wake.left.stale.text: {card} left the merge queue: its pass is stale (its revision changed since it was approved). Submit the current revision (cw_submit) for review.
queue.wake.left.stale.note: #1354: its builder's wake for a card that left the queue, its pass stale.

queue.wake.resubmitted.text: {card} is back in Review after the merge queue returned it ({failure}); {builder} {conflict, select, yes {resolved it} other {changed it}} and submitted it again: review {conflict, select, yes {the resolution} other {what changed}}
queue.wake.resubmitted.note: HI-2143: a card submitted again after the queue returned it, its reviewer's wake. {failure}: what came back (queue.failure.*). {conflict}: yes when it came back with a conflict.

queue.wake.stale.text: {card}: its pass is stale: it is for {approved}, but its line is at {current} (changed since). Submit {current} for review (cw_submit).
queue.wake.stale.note: HI-1763: a pass gone stale, its builder's wake at once (HI-1737 sat in Approved, nobody told). {approved}, {current}: short revisions ("—" for none).
